question: why current installation is slow

sourceConfirmed: plan_gate.main invokes from_environment and load_plan for every command; load_plan launches Swift verify-plan
verify-plan calls FirmwareDesiredPlanStore.read, whose validate calls FirmwareGeneration.loadVerified
validate then calls FirmwareGeneration.originalURLs, which calls loadVerified again
loadVerified verifies identity continuity and original firmware content
after a CFW inode swap, identity continuity verifies sealed postimage SHA256 and every checkpoint blob along publication ancestry
inference: Repeated complete generation/publication verification before small writes is the main identified performance problem; per-category time shares remain unmeasured
